assumptions.claim: No external consumer requires immutable task-report schema_version 2 without a bump path; v3 for new COMPLETE fields is acceptable.
assumptions.decision_reason: In-repo harnesses own the schema; bump is the documented pattern for required field growth (advisor + existing schema_version 2 already).

assumptions.claim: Refine can emit a durable report under plan_dir (or task work dir) without breaking baseline/current capture_scope contract.
assumptions.decision_reason: plan phase already freezes plan_dir absolute path; copy after validate is additive.

assumptions.claim: Primary escaped gaps are structural orphans at READY/COMPLETE boundaries rather than missing domain genius.
assumptions.decision_reason: Advisor assumption accepted for MVP scope; work-report deep audit deferred as residual (R-004 mitigation).

thesis.summary: Treat existing JSON reports as the ledger graph; add deterministic orphan/reachability rules in per-skill validators; parent re-checks child artifacts by path; Graphify stays optional advisory for impact.
thesis.approach: Phased implementation P0→P4: (P0) sam-task schema v3 + validate_child_artifacts re-running plan/refine validators from durable paths; (P1) plan gap engine under READY only (non-empty criteria, AC↔step↔proof, step reachability, depends_on acyclic, UNKNOWN probes, ASSUMPTION acceptance hygiene, hedge-vs-FACT); (P2) refine CLOSED require_pass + UNKNOWN probes; closure per-finding correction tracking; (P3) contract-only adversarial ledger pass in closure-loop; (P4) document optional Graphify impact evidence in plan evidence-policy. No shared gap_engine import; no rebrand; duplicate tiny helpers only if needed under standalone install rules.
rejected_alternatives: Rebrand/rewrite sam-task as graph engineering runtime with task-graph.json: Second serialization drifts from reports; zero extra gap detection once ID edges exist; high ceremony (advisor + simplicity rules).
Mandatory Graphify impact as READY gate: Host-dependent, non-deterministic availability; incentives to fabricate consultation; improves plan completeness not ledger integrity.
Shared cross-skill gap_engine.py library: Forbidden by validate_skill_suite standalone install contract.
Parallel DAG of canonical phases: Breaks single-final-head freshness; no latency evidence; contracts are intentionally serial.

steps.title: P1 — Plan ledger gap engine (READY-only rules)
steps.why: Closes strongest structural fail-opens (empty criteria, weak AC↔proof, unlabeled unknowns).

Every step reachable from a criterion or explicit out_of_acceptance reason
depends_on acyclic
Material UNKNOWN requires probe; immaterial requires why_immaterial (depth-aware)
ACCEPTED ASSUMPTION requires decision_reason
Tiny hedge wordlist only on FACT classification + benign fixture
One failing fixture per rule + one benign still VALID

steps.title: P2 — Refine + closure orphan rules
steps.why: Closes CLOSED-without-pass evidence and finding-without-named-correction orphans.

Finding present in iteration N open_findings and absent in N+1 must appear in N correction_receipts (stable finding ids or normalized text keys)
Harness fixtures for each rule

steps.title: P3 — Contract-only adversarial ledger pass
steps.why: Cheap human/agent self-check over P1/P2 categories without new phase/script gate.
dod: closure-loop documents one pre-review adversarial ledger pass (≤1 turn)
Output goes to residuals; no new terminal status
Skippable when cost exceeds value (explicit residual reason)

steps.title: P4 — Graphify impact as advisory evidence

dod: Document optional impact evidence kind when RC_GRAPHIFY_GRAPH_JSON available
